excerpt: Final Daya Bay oscillation result (PRL 130, 161802 (2023)), using the complete 3158-day data set. Full text gives the exact AD-configuration history: six-AD configuration 24 December 2011 to 28 July 2012 (217 days); eight-AD configuration 19 October 2012 to 20 December 2016 (1524 days); seven-AD configuration (one AD re-purposed for JUNO-related liquid-scintillator R&D) 26 January 2017 to 12 December 2020 (1417 days), after which data taking ended.
title: Precision Measurement of Reactor Antineutrino Oscillation at Kilometer-Scale Baselines by Daya Bay
